effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault, and the vault supplies it to Morpho Blue.
The vault mints shares to `receiver`, computed from the current share price rounded down, with no minimum.
Performance-fee shares go to the fee recipient on accrual. This does not change what the signer pays.
formats.shown: Deposit: the exact USDC amount, a fixed ticker 'YCSUSDC' and the share receiver; the share amount is not shown.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the share price comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: the signer received 22.726693573119148577 shares, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: YCSUSDC'.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730: the share amount depends on vault totals in storage.

findings.title: deposit shows share ticker 'YCSUSDC', but the vault token's symbol is HYCSUSDC on chain.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.vaultTicker = "YCSUSDC". The receipts of cases 0-3 show the vault token with symbol "HYCSUSDC". The constructor __symbol was "CSUSDC", and setSymbol (onlyOwner) can change it.
findings.fix: Set vaultTicker to the current on-chain symbol, or drop the raw ticker field.

cases.notes: The screen shows 24.488083 USDC out correctly. It names the shares and the receiver but not the share amount (22.73 shares).

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` vault shares to `receiver`.
The signer pays USDC equal to previewMint (rounded up), from storage totals, with no maximum bound.
The vault supplies the USDC it takes to Morpho Blue.
formats.shown: Mint: the deposit asset ticker USDC, the exact share amount and the share receiver; the USDC amount taken is not shown.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the amount is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Case 1: the signer sent 1 unit (0.000001) of USDC, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets argument to display.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint intent "Mint". The USDC payment appears only as the raw field 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint vault shares".

cases.notes: USDC out (1 unit) is shown as asset only, with no amount. The shares to 0xdead are not a signer effect, and the reader understood that correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`, computed from the share price and rounded up, with no maximum.
When the caller is not `owner`, the call spends the caller's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault withdraws exactly `assets` USDC from Morpho and sends it to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact USDC amount, the receiver and the owner; the shares burned are not shown.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares it burns from the owner; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 2: 46.525242004153414189 shares were burned, and no field shows shares.
findings.fix: None possible in ERC-7730. ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares argument.

cases.notes: The screen shows 50 USDC in to the signer correctly. The shares burned have no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`, and spends the caller's allowance when the caller is not the owner.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`, computed from the share price and rounded down, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem: the exact share amount, the receiver and the owner; the USDC paid out, both asset and amount, is not shown.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC the receiver gets; the amount is computed from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: the signer received 32.632653 USDC, and no field shows it.
findings.fix: None possible for the amount. ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets argument.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset paid out; the reader had to guess it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: only 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner'. Mint has a constant field for the underlying asset, and redeem has none. Case 3 reader: 'Which token is paid out; I assume USDC from the name but it isn't stated'.
findings.fix: Add {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem shares for USDC".

cases.notes: The screen shows 30.285415 shares out correctly. The 32.632653 USDC in is not shown at all, and the reader guessed USDC with no amount.
